claims.value: Gauge symmetry required only GSM, full RSM included, new fermions vector-like/Majorana. Extra Proca vectors need not be gauge connections of a larger group. Source treats these as EFTs below cutoff, not necessarily complete renormalizable UV theories. Generic tables allow arbitrary copies, not all mediators simultaneously.

locator.section_equations: Table1, Section5 scalar-zeta example Eqs.(5.5)-(5.7), AppendixA.7

claims.value: Explicit single-zeta example adds one complex scalar (3,3,-1/3), colour Dynkin[1,0],weak[2], to RSM. Its ql and qq couplings are interactions of the same multiplet; do not duplicate it or turn QQ contraction into an extra field.

Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

fields.derivation: Exact highest weights use dynkin-gauge-1. prepare_entry expands identified 4D Dirac/RH fermions into LH conjugates of every factor, and applies one primitive positive charge unit over the entire inventory. Retain source-coordinate row above; scalar-realification equivalence is NOT implemented.
